card.name: Word-starting 'n' or 'N' pieces
card.fires_on: The pole responds to a short piece beginning with n or N that starts or continues a word, such as the N in Norethindrone, the n in .naturalstandard, or EN in ENN. It appears where a new name or word is being spelled out.
